\n<\N[2]>Wh-What... \|What...?
\n<\N[2]>What's the meaning of this!? I thought you were

\n<\N[1]>I'm dead serious. I worked hard for that info.

\n<\N[2]>I-Is this some kind of joke...? This- This is...!
\n<\N[1]>\c[2]Look, we both know this is your fault.
\n<\N[1]>\c[2]You've been avoiding me lately, haven't you? That's
very rude of you, especially when I love you so much
and worship the ground you walk on.
\n<\N[1]>\c[2]As I collected this information, I racked my brain
for answers... How can she not understand how
I feel? What am I doing wrong?
\n<\N[1]>\c[2]But I finally understand now. It's what I do,
or rather, what I don't do.
\n<\N[1]>\c[2]I'm a good planner, but I lack the ability to actually
execute. Even the best plan is useless if you can't
put it into action. That goes without saying.
\n<\N[1]>\c[2]So I'm done with plans. I've made up my mind,
Hazuki, my angel. I'll make you mine right now.
\n<\N[2]>...You're crazy! You've gone completely crazy.
You need to stop with this nonsense right now.
\n<\N[2]>You're weirding me out, grossing me out, and every

you were this kind of person... You've let me down.
\n<\N[1]>\c[2]It's fine. I just need to take my time and make you
